correctness.rationale: For all n>=4 and two distinct nonzero integer values, normalize the minority multiplicity 1<=m<=floor(n²/2); every matrix is rJ+delta C. For m>=3 use the exact directed 3-cycle on the first three columns and pad remaining ones in columns 4..n; (1,omega,omega²,0,..) is a J-null nonreal eigenvector. n>=5 has capacity n(n-3)>=m-3; n=4,m<=7 pads in column 4, while the displayed eight-one 4x4 witness has eigenvalue delta omega². For m=2 Cheng-Zhang Theorem 5.4 cubic discriminant is strictly negative for r delta !=0. For m=1 Theorem 5.2 gives the two rational-square discriminants; monic integer characteristic polynomials convert rational eigenvalues to integers. Explicit cube-root and capacity calculations were independently reproduced. Symmetry swapping values and nonzero hypotheses are essential.
